$comment: Consumer accepts the Offer terms - IDS Protocol. Despite this file's name (kept for continuity with the documented 7-component format), the two DSP messages involved are distinct: (1) the Consumer's acceptance shown here is a ContractNegotiationEventMessage (event: ACCEPTED), OFFERED -> ACCEPTED; (2) the Provider then separately builds and sends the Agreement via ContractAgreementMessage, ACCEPTED -> AGREED - see finalized-agreement.json and state-transitions.json for that step. Per DSP 2025-1, ContractAgreementMessage is always Provider-sent, never Consumer-sent.

constraints: Legal address country code must equal PL
